entries.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro Tech Blog: Advancing Open Intelligence
entries.summary: Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro, our most capable 3T-class open-weight model with 1M-token context and major advances in coding, 3D modeling, and financial research.

entries.title: Kimi K3 Tech Blog: Open Frontier Intelligence
entries.summary: Kimi K3 is the world's first open 3T-class model — frontier performance across coding, knowledge work, and reasoning, with native multimodality and 1M context.

entries.title: Kimi K2.6 Tech Blog: Advancing Open-Source Coding
entries.summary: Kimi K2.6 advances open-source coding, featuring long-horizon coding, coding-driven design, agent swarms, proactive agents, and the Claw Groups research preview.

entries.title: Kimi K2.5 Tech Blog: Visual Agentic Intelligence
entries.summary: Kimi K2.5 defines Visual Agentic Intelligence. Trained on 15T tokens, it introduces SOTA visual coding and autonomous agent swarm. Read the full tech blog.

entries.title: PerceptionBench: Evaluating Atomic Visual Perception in MLLMs
entries.summary: PerceptionBench evaluates visual perception at the level of atomic capabilities discovered from model failures, measuring what multimodal models actually see rather than what they infer.

entries.title: Kimi Agent Swarm: 100 Sub-Agents at Scale
entries.summary: Kimi Agent Swarm is a self-organizing multi-agent system that spawns up to 100 sub-agents to parallelize research, document synthesis, and multi-perspective analysis.

entries.title: WorldVQA: Measuring Atomic World Knowledge in MLLMs
entries.summary: WorldVQA is a benchmark designed to evaluate atomic vision-centric world knowledge in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs).
